newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela police seize heroin on Colombia border.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela police seize heroin on Colombia border.

text.p: Venezuelan police seized 68 pounds (31 kg) of heroin in the mountainous south-western state of Tachira, near the Colombian border, and arrested six people recently with the help of Colombian anti-drug agencies, a senior Venezuelan official said on Monday.
Jose Enrique Maldonado, head of the National Guard's anti-drugs investigation unit, told reporters that with the seizure of the drugs Colombia's drug cartels have suffered a serious blow.
The U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) rates Colombia as the No.1 supplier of high grade heroin to the United States.
